subject.title: fix: block workspace dotenv endpoint overrides [AI]

question: Should all endpoint-style environment variables be treated as trusted-source-only controls, accepting that existing workspace `.env` endpoint settings will stop loading?
rationale: The patch correctly closes a network-redirection gap and follows prior hardening, but only maintainers can formally accept the upgrade compatibility cost of an unconditional fail-closed boundary.

options.title: Accept the generic boundary
options.body: Treat every `_ENDPOINT` variable as trusted-source-only and land after real behavior proof confirms the supported replacement paths.

options.title: Add transition diagnostics
options.body: Keep the generic block but first add a visible warning or doctor guidance for ignored workspace endpoint keys.

options.title: Narrow the block
options.body: Block only specifically approved endpoint variables, accepting future denylist drift in exchange for less immediate compatibility impact.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic boundary
recommendation.body: Treat every `_ENDPOINT` variable as trusted-source-only and land after real behavior proof confirms the supported replacement paths.

likelyOwner.reason: The area history is shared, and steipete has the strongest broad contribution signal across the dotenv and host-security surfaces for the final compatibility/security-boundary choice.
